←  ☐ /model  ☐ MCP prompts  ✔ Submit  →

│ Measured on Claude 2.1.318 and Codex 0.160.1: in both /model pickers, Enter
│ SAVES the pick as your default for new sessions (~/.claude/settings.json,
│ ~/.codex/config.toml); only the picker's `s` key is "this session only".
│ Claude's `/model <name>` with an argument also saves the default. What should
│ choosing a model from the chat do?

❯ 1. Session only (Recommended)
     The chat answers the picker with `s`: this session only, never writes your
     config. `/model <name>` with an argument is refused in the chat (pick from
     the list instead). Defaults stay a terminal act.
  2. Save as default
     Faithful to the terminal's Enter: the pick becomes the default for new
     sessions (writes your settings). The chat's confirm would say so.
  3. Offer both
     Each model choice shows two actions in the chat: "This session" and "Make
     default" (the second needs a confirm, and admin on the phone).
  4. Type something.
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  5. Chat about this

Enter to select · Tab/Arrow keys to navigate · Esc to cancel
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── scA-main ─
